objectives: Evaluate current trends and issues in workforce development and work-based training.
Describe current strategies for educating the workforce in the United States and specifically Georgia.
Discuss the economic impact of work-based education.
Describe the workforce education policies of other countries.
Identify and describe the steps involved in organizing a work-based learning program.
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of each work-based learning program model.
Differentiate between each work-based learning program model and their targeted population.
Plan and develop curriculum and implementation plan for a work-based learning program model.

objectives: Students will be able to apply concepts and theories learned in previous coursework to a real-world project, demonstrating their understanding through practical implementation.
Students will develop skills in defining project scope, creating timelines, allocating resources, managing risks, and effectively executing a project plan.
Students will practice research methodologies, collect and analyze relevant data, interpret results, and draw meaningful conclusions.
Students will be able to identify and analyze complex problems, develop creative solutions, and evaluate their effectiveness in a project context.
Students will be able to effectively communicate project findings and ideas both verbally and in writing to diverse audiences, including clients, stakeholders, and peers.
Students will gain experience in professional practices relevant to their field, such as project documentation, presentation skills, and ethical considerations.
Students will take initiative, self-manage their learning process, and seek out necessary information to complete the project successfully.
topics: Project Topic Selection and Proposal Development
Developing a detailed project proposal Design
Selecting appropriate methods (qualitative, quantitative, mixed methods, creative applications)
Strategies for collection and/or development of resources
Interpretation or reflection Project Implementation and Evaluation
Assessing project outcomes and impact Final Report and Presentation
